research_mode: official Home Office primary statistical bulletin; fail-closed limitations; no parcel score or business result

sources.name: Publication scope
verified_claims: The bulletin reports investigative outcomes assigned to notifiable offences recorded in England and Wales between 1 April 2025 and 31 March 2026.
limitations: The reporting period is national and does not identify parcel-level conditions.

sources.name: Fraud chapter publication boundary
verified_claims: The fraud and Computer Misuse Act outcomes chapter was excluded while City of London Police aligned legacy Action Fraud data with Report Fraud.
limitations: Missing fraud outcome data must not be imputed from other crime categories.

sources.name: Weapon subset definition
verified_claims: Firearm and knife or sharp instrument offences are subsets of other offence categories rather than separate offence categories.
limitations: Subset figures must not be added to broad offence totals as if mutually exclusive.

sources.name: Victim-based offence definition
verified_claims: Victim-based offences include violence against the person, sexual offences, theft, robbery, and criminal damage and arson.
limitations: This grouping is analytical and does not establish local exposure for a specific property.

sources.name: Non-victim-based offence definition
verified_claims: Non-victim-based offences include public disorder, drug offences, possession of weapons, handling stolen goods, and other offences against the state.
limitations: Police activity and enforcement priorities can strongly affect these recorded volumes.

sources.name: Robbery charge or summons rate
verified_claims: The robbery charge or summons rate increased from 7.5% to 10.5% compared with the previous year.
limitations: The rate reflects case outcomes and investigation maturity, not neighbourhood safety.

sources.name: Theft charge or summons rate
verified_claims: The theft charge or summons rate increased from 7.3% to 9.1% compared with the previous year.
limitations: The rate cannot be interpreted as the probability of detection for a specific incident.

sources.name: Sexual offence evidential difficulties
verified_claims: Evidential-difficulty outcomes accounted for 47.6% of sexual offences.
limitations: Outcome categories describe investigation closure and do not measure offence prevalence.

sources.name: Rape evidential difficulties
verified_claims: Evidential-difficulty outcomes accounted for 51.7% of rape offences.
limitations: The figure is national and subject to later outcome revisions.

sources.name: Victim-based evidential difficulties baseline
verified_claims: Evidential-difficulty outcomes accounted for 39.0% of all victim-based offences.
limitations: Broad outcome shares should not be transferred to local parcels.
